ideas.pitch: An automated sorting bin that uses a low-cost camera and edge AI to classify recyclable vs. organic waste in real time.
ideas.title: RoboSorter: AI Garbage Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unusual physical build and practical robotics demonstration pattern, which stands out strongly at automation and robotics school venues.

ideas.pitch: A compact tracked rover equipped with ultrasonic sensors and SLAM-lite path planning to navigate complex indoor obstacle courses autonomously.
ideas.title: LineBot Nav: Autonomous Obstacle-Avoiding Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core domain of the University School of Automation & Robotics by showcasing precise sensor integration and live mobility.

ideas.pitch: A 3D-printed robotic arm controlled in real-time via hand-tracking webcams using kinematics mapping.
ideas.title: GestureArm: Computer Vision Robotic Manipulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a visually striking mechanical build with an intuitive, interactive live demo that judges can personally test during evaluation.

ideas.pitch: A mini-tractor robot designed for precise grid-based seed dropping and soil moisture logging.
ideas.title: AgriBot: Automated Seed Planting Mechanism
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world agricultural automation challenges with a hardware-first approach that appeals to engineering faculty judges.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-based telemetry dashboard that streams live motor current, RPM, and temperature metrics to a local web client over WebSockets.
ideas.title: IoT Telemetry Rig: Real-time Robotic Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges low-level hardware debugging with modern software tooling, proving robustness and reliability in automated systems.
